rows.old_zh:
SHIFT 换人：障碍只认一种身体，换错就撞（换人间隔 0.2 秒）
↑ 兔子跳 / 乌龟跃起    ↓ 兔子趴低 / 乌龟下潜
礁拱：乌龟潜过去；鲨鱼：乌龟跃起；
低梁/海鸟/吊网：趴低或下潜；岩/箱/浮台：跳过去
浮木：先 ↑ 跳，再 SHIFT 给乌龟 ↓ 潜
高墙：SHIFT + ↑ 跃起，再 SHIFT 兔子 ↑ 蹬踏
食物：操控谁谁吃，不吃不扣分
rows.old_en:
SHIFT SWAP: EACH OBSTACLE FITS ONE BODY (0.2s BETWEEN SWAPS)
↑ RABBIT JUMP / TURTLE LEAP    ↓ RABBIT CROUCH / TURTLE DIVE
ARCH: TURTLE DIVE; SHARK/EEL: TURTLE LEAP
BEAM/NET/GULL: CROUCH OR DIVE; ROCK/CRATE/PONTOON: JUMP
LOG: ↑ JUMP FIRST, SHIFT, THEN ↓ DIVE
HIGH WALL: SHIFT + ↑ LEAP, SHIFT RABBIT, ↑ KICK
SNACK: WHOEVER YOU DRIVE EATS; SKIPPING IS FREE
rows.new_zh:
SHIFT 换人：TUBO ↑ 跳 / ↓ 趴低；BITT ↑ 跃起 / ↓ 下潜\nTUBO 头顶三颗气泡是氧气；BRO METER 满会让当前角色电流过载\n电击换手 · 干净通过攒 BRO COMBO · 组合动作触发 SHOWTIME
SPACE：TUBO 胡萝卜护盾 / BITT 主动救援
rows.new_en:
SHIFT SWAP: TUBO ↑ JUMP / ↓ CROUCH; BITT ↑ LEAP / ↓ DIVE\nTHREE BUBBLES OVER TUBO ARE AIR; A FULL BRO METER OVERLOADS THE CURRENT BODY\nSHIFT RELAY · CLEAN PASSES BUILD BRO COMBO · COMBOS TRIGGER SHOWTIME
SPACE: TUBO CARROT GUARD / BITT BRO CATCH
